AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: HAdo manages the user's to-do lists, which live in Home Assistant or on this device. Operational patterns: use createTask to add a task or reminder to one of the user's lists, optionally naming the list and giving a due date and due time; use listTodoLists to find out which lists exist. Constraints: only lists the user shows in HAdo can be used, and a due time needs a due date.
